AcpAgentSettings.description:
One ACP agent a runtime hosts, as configured
(`[runtimes.<id>.acp.agents.<agent>]`; runtime protocol 1.7.0).

command.description: The program and its arguments, run without a shell.

env.description: Variables merged over the runtime's environment.

id.description:
The table key: an agent ID (lowercase letters, digits, and single
inner hyphens).

max_bytes.description:
Files larger than this are skipped. At most
the `AGENTS.md` event bound.

McpServerSettings.description: One MCP server of a runtime template.

config.description: The server's table, as the `[mcp.servers.<name>]` schema reads it.

RuntimeSettings.description:
What the daemon's configuration says about the runtime's work. A runtime
rejects settings it does not support.

acp_agents.description:
The template's ACP agents, which the runtime starts on its own
machine (runtime protocol 1.7.0). A runtime that hosts no agents
rejects a nonempty list; one that gets none hosts its own machine's.

mcp_servers.description:
The template's MCP servers, which the runtime hosts on its own
machine. A runtime that hosts no MCP servers rejects a nonempty list.

description:
`runtime/settings_changed` (runtime protocol 1.10.0): the runtime's
